newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank 9-month operating profit up 9.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank 9-month operating profit up 9.9 pct.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit after provisions 808.1 up 9.9 pct
Group own-account trading profit 130.3 up 6.5 pct
Group net interest income 3,351.4 up 8.3 pct
Group net commission income 662.5 up 7.8 pct

NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG. Results compare with first nine months of 1995. Forecasts for the operating profit after provisions had averaged 915 million marks and ranged from 910 million to 920 million marks.

NOTE - All figures were released in a mandatory statement. The bank will hold a news conference later today. The bank also said its cost-income ratio improved to 57.9 percent versus 59.8 percent at the end of 1995.
